articles.summary: Ecolab Inc., a global leader in water, hygiene, and infection prevention solutions and services, today announced its recognition by Selling Power as one of the 60 Best Companies to Sell For in 2026.
articles.title: Ecolab Named to Selling Power's 60 Best Companies to Sell For 2026 List

articles.summary: Ecolab today announced the close of its acquisition of CoolIT Systems, a leader in direct liquid cooling for high‑density data centers. The transaction closed earlier than expected, and Ecolab welcomes the world-class CoolIT team to the company.
articles.title: Ecolab Closes CoolIT Acquisition and Expands AI Cooling Platform as Global High Tech Business Targets $4 Billion by 2030
